fixture_name: A9 Ballinluig SB signage/VRS-adjacent visibility — real UK Stage 1&2 RSA (Transport Scotland OGL release)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Constrained forward visibility on a junction approach curve shared by verge-walking pedestrians and entering drivers is a genuine, substantive safety issue directly relevant to a Stage 1 review of the scheme.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim (curve-plus-vegetation reduces forward visibility and requires cut-back for pedestrian passage) is anchored in a verbatim quote from EV-UK-025, exceeding registry-id-only citation; EV-UK-002 supplies supporting context.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Maintains the GG 119 safety-concern frame without asserting compliance claims, and mirrors the Overseeing-Organisation-accepted problem/agreed-action structure; only minor tension is that 'evidence before handover' edges toward implementation oversight beyond strict Stage 1 remit.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific, actionable and viable: deliver extended clearance covering both logged locations and confirm post-clearance driver visibility and unobstructed pedestrian passage, giving measurable closure criteria.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are explicitly named as affected road users and the unobstructed pedestrian passage is a core element of both the concern and the recommendation, fully integrating VRU impacts.

justifications.substance: Obscured sight lines to a high-speed off-slip terminus undermining driver awareness of the slowing requirement is a substantive safety concern directly defeating the signage scheme's purpose.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim is anchored by a verbatim quote from cited EV-UK-025 ('Vegetation affects views to end of slip road, reducing driver awareness of requirement to slow'), exceeding registry-id-only citation.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Maintains a categorical safety-concern framing consistent with GG 119 Stage 1 semantics, keeping the RSA problem distinct from any compliance question and tying verification to the recorded RSA action.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: drive-through verification at design speed after clearance, with early-visibility criterion and handover-file recording; concrete, viable, and not null.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not plausibly exposed on the slip carriageway approach, and the finding explicitly acknowledges their exclusion while scoping to vehicle occupants.
